interactables.name: Rosa
interactables.text: The Maid, [Rosa], is chopping vegetables with feeling. The cleaver hits the board like a verdict. A ring of [house keys] jingles at her apron with every chop. Without turning around: 'If you are here about the bird, get in line.'

topics.text: The cleaver stops mid-air. 'That bird called my paella [garbage slop]. In front of guests. Eleven years I run this kitchen.' Chop. 'Did I dream of roasting him with a nice sofrito? A woman is allowed her dreams.' Chop. 'Now he is gone, and everyone looks at Rosa. Maybe they are not wrong to look.'

topics.prompt: Sit hopefully beneath the treat jar
topics.text: She sighs like the tide going out, wipes her hands, and shakes exactly three treats into a saucer. '[For the cat],' she says, softer than the room deserves. 'You saw nothing. I have a reputation.' The treats are excellent. Your objectivity is now a memory.

topics.prompt: Give her a slow, skeptical blink
topics.text: 'What. WHAT.' She points the cleaver at nothing in particular. 'Seven o'clock I take the [dinner cart] to the east wing, same as every night. Soup, roast, the little breads.' Chop. 'Mister Derek did not even lift his headphones to say thank you. Ask HIM who else was rolling things around up there.'

topics.prompt: Lay your solved case notes at her feet, gently
topics.text: She reads your board the way she reads a delivery invoice: fast, twice, looking for the cheat. Then she sets down the cleaver.|'So. The cart, the note, the skull. You did the arithmetic and it comes out Rosa.' She crouches to your eye level, which nobody does. 'Then do the rest of it, detective. My cart is heavy going out and light coming back - and that night the wing smelled of soup and [cable grease]. Soup was mine. Kitchens know their smells. Find whose the other one was.'

interactables.name: Note on the Fridge
interactables.text: A note pinned to the fridge: 'That bird called my paella [garbage slop]. In front of guests.' Someone drew a [skull] next to it.
Rosa's paella. You sniff it. It smells extraordinary. Whatever Rudebeak said about this dish, [he was wrong].

A ceramic jar on the counter, labeled '[FOR THE CAT].' Rosa keeps treats. For you. Specifically. You are now morally conflicted about having her on the suspect list. If this is a bribe, it is working.

A crate by the pantry - tonight's roast, plucked in-house. Beside it, a bin of [feathers]. You freeze. You look closer. Small ones. Plain ones. [Probably] the roast's. You keep one eye on that bin anyway.

interactables.name: Duty Roster
interactables.text:
The kitchen duty roster, pinned by the door:
- [5:45 - herbs in from the garden - B.]
- 6:30 - plating
- [7:00 PM - dinner cart, east wing - R.]
- 8:30 - clear service
The east wing is where the bedrooms are.
